Warming stripes

How to read them
A cooler yearbelow the average
An average yearclose to 1961–2010
A warmer yearabove the average
  • One stripe is one year: the average temperature of that year in one place.
  • Blue is cooler, red is warmer than the 1961–2010 average.
  • Side by side, from the 1850s to 2025, read from left to right.
cooler1961–2010 averagewarmer
